correctness.rationale: The gradient (Z^3,X^3,Y^3) verifies smoothness. The exact directional Taylor expansion has no quadratic term. Comparison of the cubic coefficient with the cube of the tangent yields the necessary/sufficient conditions b=u^10, u^91=1 and u^28+u^7+1=0, with no omitted coordinate points. The separable factorization v^4+v+1=(v-1)(v^3+v^2+v-1) and its divisibility by v^13-1 establishes all 28 geometric roots, with multiplicative orders 1,7,13,91 counted 1,6,3,18. Their Frobenius periods 1,6,3,6 give precisely six cycles, and normalized tangent coefficients show fields coincide. Bézout excludes two-point bitangents. A standalone exact GF(729) enumerator from the actual embedded source passed but is not used as an infinite proof.

An exact minimal splitting field, orbit decomposition and uniform rational-count formula identify the rational twist in its standard integral plane model, information not fixed by the known geometric 28 count or isomorphism to a Hermitian curve.
